items.title: Preston Jackson Interview, 1958-06-02
items.q: And the first time I saw Lewis, and I told Lewis about it... And we came up here, we made friends

ctx.x: The first little band I played in. So I was going to ask a little bit to you about the parades and the second line.

Yeah, well the second line, the second line. I guess I just always was crazy about music. Doing that whistling and going on I did. I guess it just was destined for me to be a musician. I believe in predestination. I believe when a person is first born, that is like a big book, there's so much he's supposed to accomplish in life, you understand? And then leave this world. Now the way I used to whistle and take the sticks and pound and go on like that, and hear that music, I could follow the music for miles. It's a…
Oh Diddy Ramble. Oh diddy Ramble. Oh diddy Ramble around the town. To the little butchie cut him down.
